# UpdateBuilder.Build method

Builds the SQL UPDATE statement.

```csharp
public string Build()
```

## Return Value

A string containing the generated SQL UPDATE statement.

## Remarks

This builder automatically excludes primary keys, database-generated columns, and computed columns from the SET clause. The WHERE clause is generated using the primary key columns.
